environment.freecad_setup: Official portable Windows archive, not a system-wide installer

timing.method: Elapsed wall time estimated from local file creation/write timestamps, not a controlled benchmark. Includes setup, scripting, checks, an early reopen and waits; excludes the final independent comparison of all four files and subsequent editorial work.

versions.change: Main-bedroom extension of a 1.76 m by 1 m floor-marker strip; exterior footprint changes
Three-metre full-height opening in kitchen/living partition
West living window widened from 1.2 m to 1.8 m; south kitchen window from 1.2 m to 1.6 m

model.limits: Visual concept only. No site, furnishings, roof, services, structural analysis, daylight calculation, accessibility, fire safety or building-code assessment. Room tags and boolean checks do not establish fitness for construction.

later_visualization.method: Additional FreeCAD viewport exports created after the timed experiment. Floor markers were recoloured for clarity, white margins were cropped, and numbered room labels were added in the article.
